content: Koraisa Inyimungu Porai RengePaleta Karenge

Nakama Yesu Koraisana arapu dokona karami dokome porainyi pyambulyase? Banya mona retenge dokome nakamana mona poraikalyase? Nakama Imambupa role pyao yalya kando karamisi? Nakama mendali mendali anjiki pyuo mona reto pyuo karamisi?
Dopa pyuo piyande kande doko suu pingi mendakinya suu pyao mona mendaki palyuo rale rale pii nao nambana rae maingi renge doko andanyi pyambwarami lao poraiyuo langilyu.

Rango nao range namba keta palipyali lao dee suu pingi koo suu pyao range ketae pyambuo lakando pii narami. Namba range wakasa lao masa nao wambu wakale dupwa mupwa lao suu pyao inyimungu karo mendali kondo kondo lao kararami.
Nakama rangena ikinya lao suu pyaa nao mendeme mendena kando nyiso pirami.
Yesu Koraisa suu piyamuli pyuo suu pyaro karalapape langilyu.

content.text: Yesu baa Anatu angiko ingyuo karenge.
Baa rangeme sisu lao Anatu yale ingyuo karapuli lao suu pyaa naya.
Baa range banya peparae yaki nyuo kaepala
kendemande akali ingyuo karapala
mee isa wambu dokore isa komba pyao epeya.
Epapala baa mee isa akali ingyuo ando kareya.
Yesu baa akali kukiŋi lao inyimungu karo
Anatu dokona warombo sepala baa leyamuli pyuo kumuya.
Kinyi baa isa mamandona kumuo paleya.
Renge dokona lao Anatumi baa minyalyuo nyiya.
Anatumi minyalyuo nyepala baa kingi andake maiyamo doko
kingi doloma nyuo isa palyiyasa piya.
Yesunya kingi dokona lao
wambu peparaepe imambupi yake pandape isa yuu dakenape
dee isa yuu dorena palenge dupwapeme
wapambu pii pyaro piso banya kingi lakandarami.
Lakando dokopa wambu peparaeme
Yesu Koraisa doko baa Kamongo doko lao kararami.
Dopa pyuo lakandarami dokome
Rakange Anatunya kingi ketae pyambuo parasa pira.

content: Iminjingi Panda Dorena Kendapulinya Mendeke Ingyuo Karalapape

Nambana puu minyingi dupwa yuu peparae namba nakama pipya role pyao kareyonopa nakama warombo siyami kande. Doko suu pyao epapu dakepa namba nakama pipya kara nalyamano doŋo nambana pii warombo serami ramo doko ama keyange wakasa ingyara. Neta pasaramaŋa lao pakame kumuo walu walu lao Anatunya Imambunya yulu dokona pyuoko karalapape.
Anatumi nakama keta yuu peparae waa waa karanyi pyambuo dee banya renge dupwana warombo serami lao pingi.
Yuu peparae mumu lao laiya lao pii napala rae maiyuo karalapape.

Dopa pirami ramo doko nakama koo pii nao poo pyasi ingyuo kararami. Nakama Anatunya wane wanakepe koo isa palya nange dupwa yuu dakena wambu koo pyuo rango nao karenge dokona role pyao palirami ingilyamo. Nakamame bui yake dokona rao karenge dopale ingyapala,

waili pii wambu lete wai pyao nyingi doko lamaiyuo karalapape. Dopa pyuo pirami ramo doko Koraisa epara yuu gii dokopa nakamana lao suu pyao rae maipala lakandaro. Dokome nambame yulu andake pyakayono doko mee ingyuo paa naya lao pano lasaka pira.

Nakamana Anatu kapa ingingi lao suu pingi doko rendamu pingi kiso Anatu maingi dopale ingyuo pelyamo. Doko nambana ranjama kulimbwaraminyipa nakama suu pingi keyange pale pale Anatu dokona para ingilyamo. Dopa pira ramo doko namba rae mairu dokona nakama opetae rae maiyuo karalapape.
Mendaki dopaleko ingyuo nakama opetae rae mairaminyi dee namba opetae nakama pipya rae mairamako.
Timotipa Ipaporaitasapana Pii Doko
Kamongo Yesumi nyisaramopa nakama karaminyi dokona Timoti pena laro ingilyamo. Timoti baame nakamana yulu dokona lao langyuo jeramo dokopa nambana mona porainyi pyambwara.
Namba nakama mona retapala suu pyaro karo doko suu pyao baako mendeke ingyuo pelyamo.
Wambu menge dupwa nakama rangena iki suu pyao Yesu Koraisana yulu dokona rae mai nao karaminyi.

Nakama Timotinya yulu wambo kandapala baa akali keyange dokona nakama range soo gisilyaminyi. Timotipa nambapa ikinyingi rakangepa dopale karambano dokome waili pii dokona reke lao yulu mendare role pyao pingi doko soo gisilyaminyiko.
Dokona lao namba keta apa pira lao soo nyepala aopa nakama karaminyi dokona pena larolyamo lao suu pyao karo.
Kamongome nyisaramopa namba range rengya usale eparolyamo lao silyu.

Namwana yangonge Ipaporaitasa nambapa role pyao yulu andake pyuo waili piinya lao kareyamba. Doko nakamame namba nyiso Ipaporaitasa jiyaminyipa nakamana wai pii minyuo papyuo kareya. Doko baa nakama keta pena laro lao suu piyu.
Baa nakama peparae kandapuli yaka lao letamo. Nakama baa anga pyalyamo lao siyami. Siyaminyi dokona baa mona randalyamo.
Kinyi baa anga andake piyamo repeta kumuyamopape Anatumi baa kondapala nyisiya. Baa dokona iki sakao kondayande daa. Baa namba opetaeko kondapala namba kyawa minyiya.
Dokona lao nakama rae wakasa mairami lao baa nakama kandala ipyali lao leto. Kandala eparamo dokopa namba mona kenda pii nara.
Baa Kurisene akali yango dokona lao rae maiyuo yako lao kando nyelapape. Akali baa yale dupwa opetaeko yako lao lakandalapape.
Nakama rangeme nanesale karapala namba nyisalana saka nayaminyi dokona baame nyiso pyakaya. Doko Yesu Koraisana yulu dokona reke lao baa kumara repe ingiya.
